item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"claim_1","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The repro performs a file round-trip: it saves a `dspy.Predict` that already has an attached LM, reopens the saved JSON, and manually injects an endpoint override under the serialized `lm` object (for example `api_base`).","span_ids":["span_safe_file_roundtrip"]},{"claim_id":"claim_2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Loading the edited file through the default path must still reconstruct the LM object, so the safe reload has `lm` present rather than failing or leaving it unset.","span_ids":["span_safe_file_roundtrip"]},{"claim_id":"claim_3","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"That same default load must ignore the injected endpoint override, so the safe reload's `lm.kwargs` does not contain the override by default.","span_ids":["span_safe_file_roundtrip"]},{"claim_id":"claim_4","claim_type":"core","weight":25,"statement":"A second load of the same edited file with `allow_unsafe_lm_state=True` must preserve the injected override, so the opt-in reload exposes that value in `lm.kwargs`.","span_ids":["span_unsafe_file_roundtrip"]},{"claim_id":"claim_5","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The safe/unsafe difference comes from load-time sanitization: unsafe LM-state keys such as `api_base` are filtered before rebuilding `self.lm` unless `allow_unsafe_lm_state=True` is passed.","span_ids":["span_sanitize_lm_state","span_predict_load_state"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"span_sanitize_lm_state","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":22,"end_line":40},{"span_id":"span_predict_load_state","path":"dspy/predict/predict.py","start_line":92,"end_line":111},{"span_id":"span_safe_file_roundtrip","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":262,"end_line":284},{"span_id":"span_unsafe_file_roundtrip","path":"tests/predict/test_predict.py","start_line":286,"end_line":306}]}
